contour_development_replay.note: Same-source development check on JPEG 96 re-encodings; tests tune the gates on this recording. Counts measure accepted contour registrations, not independent accuracy, successful walking, or the complete asynchronous sensor pipeline.

ct_stop.note: Remaining sampled frames show the console over the radar. No predicted motion is permitted through an unreadable frame.

red_door_stop.confirmation: Measured crossing of calibrated door plane; not a declaration that the game accepted E.

negative_map_check.note: Selected existing atlas crops at calibrated zoom; not exhaustive.

synthetic_controller.note: Intercepted inputs and synthetic door physics; no Windows or CS2 input was sent.

limits: Door reach and timing need Windows/CS2 confirmation.
Opposite-side door appearance is not demonstrated by this video.
No claim of perfect traversal over all Inferno spawns or dynamic obstacles.
